description: This file defines the AccessTokenRepository class, which manages OAuth access tokens within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for persisting new tokens, revoking tokens, checking if a token is revoked, generating new tokens, and retrieving tokens by ID. It implements the OAuth2 Server's AccessTokenRepositoryInterface and interacts with the database to store and retrieve access token data.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth access tokens, including creation, revocation, validation, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Stores a new access token entity in the database, handling duplication exceptions.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks the specified access token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the specified access token has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Generates a new access token entity with provided client, scopes, and user identifier.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token entity from the database by token ID.
